title: Shutter Island
author: Dennis Lehane
summary: In 1954 a U.S. marshal and his partner travel to an island hospital for the criminally insane to find a patient who has vanished from a locked room. A hurricane cuts them off, and the staff are hiding something.
readIf: you like a claustrophobic mystery with a storm, a gothic setting and an ending you will want to discuss.
skipIf: you would rather have a straightforward procedural with no twists.

pairings.reason: Another psychiatric-setting thriller built around one big revelation.
Same author, a slower and more tragic crime novel set in a Boston neighbourhood.
A classic set inside a psychiatric ward, asking who is really sick.
